---
title: "Mission Bio scDNA-seq: Cohort Mutation Summary"
output: html_notebook
---

# Overview

This notebook summarises somatic mutations detected by Mission Bio targeted
scDNA-seq across the VHR-ALL cohort. It covers:

1. **Data preparation** — load, format, and filter mutation and sample metadata
2. **Germline SNP removal** — flag and remove variants overlapping common dbSNP entries
3. **Mutation frequency adjustment** — correct raw mutation rates for the
   proportion of leukemic cells loaded per sample
4. **Gene-level heatmap** — mutation frequency per gene × patient × stage
5. **Mutation-level heatmap** — per-variant view with identical layout
6. **IDX → MRD frequency change** — scatterplot and histograms of change per mutation
7. **Panel characterisation** — amplicon and mutation counts by gene and origin
8. **PeCAN overlap** — how many cohort mutations appear in PeCAN database
9. **Chang et al. (MP2PRT) overlap** — comparison with the Genomic Determinants
   of Outcome in ALL publication

---

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
`%notin%` <- Negate(`%in%`)
```

---

# Section 1: Load and format data

```{r load-data, message=FALSE}
mut.all           <- fread(path.mut.all)
pt.meta           <- read.delim(path.pt.meta)
k_cluster         <- read.csv(path.k.cluster, row.names = 2)
proportion.leukemic <- read_tsv(path.prop.leukemic)

# Germline SNP reference sets
# Standard VCF column names are applied manually since dbSNP overlap files
# have no header.
vcf_cols <- c("CHROM", "POS", "ID", "REF", "ALT", "QUAL", "FILTER",
               "INFO", "FORMAT", "SAMPLE")

format_germline_snps <- function(path) {
  df <- read_tsv(path, col_names = FALSE)
  colnames(df) <- vcf_cols
  df |>
    mutate(CHROM = paste0("chr", CHROM)) |>
    separate_rows(ALT, sep = ",") |>
    mutate(ID  = ifelse(is.na(ID), paste0(CHROM, "_", POS, "_", REF, "_", ALT), ID),
           ALT = ifelse(ALT == ".", "*", ALT)) |>
    unite(col = "combMut", CHROM, POS, REF, ALT, sep = ":", remove = FALSE)
}

germline.snps.common <- format_germline_snps(path.germline.common)
germline.snps.all    <- format_germline_snps(path.germline.all)

cat("Common germline SNPs overlapping cohort mutations:",
    sum(germline.snps.common$combMut %in% mut.all$scDNA_variant_GRCh38), "\n")
cat("All germline SNPs overlapping cohort mutations:",
    sum(germline.snps.all$combMut    %in% mut.all$scDNA_variant_GRCh38), "\n")
```

# Section 2: Identify samples for fishplots

Samples where 100% of loaded cells are leukemic (proportion_leukemic_cells == 1)
and that have more than one timepoint are candidates for clonal evolution fishplots.

```{r fishplot-samples}
all.leukemic <- proportion.leukemic |>
  dplyr::filter(proportion_leukemic_cells == 1.00) |>
  left_join(pt.meta |> dplyr::select(file_prefix, patient),
            by = join_by(sample == file_prefix)) |>
  group_by(patient) |>
  mutate(n = n()) |>
  dplyr::filter(n > 1)

write.csv(all.leukemic,
          file.path(dir.plots, "../Tables/AllLeukemic_samples_for_fishplots.csv"))
```

---

# Section 3: Mutation frequency adjustment and filtering

Raw `scDNA_prop_cells_mutated` is divided by the fraction of leukemic cells
loaded to obtain a leukemic-cell-adjusted mutation frequency. Mutations where
the adjusted frequency exceeds the leukemic proportion (biologically impossible)
are removed.

```{r adjust-mutation-frequency}
# Join leukemic proportion and adjust mutation rate
mut.all <- left_join(mut.all, proportion.leukemic,
                     by = c("multiome_sample" = "sample")) |>
  mutate(scDNA_prop_cells_mutated_adj =
           (scDNA_n_01 + scDNA_n_11) /
           (scDNA_n_cells * proportion_leukemic_cells))

# Remove mutations where adjusted rate exceeds leukemic proportion
n_removed <- sum(mut.all$proportion_leukemic_cells <
                   mut.all$scDNA_prop_cells_mutated, na.rm = TRUE)
cat("Mutations removed (rate > leukemic proportion):", n_removed, "\n")
mut.all <- dplyr::filter(mut.all,
                          proportion_leukemic_cells > scDNA_prop_cells_mutated)

# Build human-readable mutation string (protein change or cDNA change)
mut.all <- mut.all |>
  mutate(
    aa_ref       = str_extract(VEP_Amino_acids, "^[A-Z*]"),
    aa_alt       = str_extract(VEP_Amino_acids, "[A-Z*]$"),
    hgvs_c_short = ifelse(!is.na(VEP_HGVSc) & VEP_HGVSc != "",
                           str_replace(VEP_HGVSc, "^[^:]*:", ""), NA_character_),
    mut_string   = case_when(
      !is.na(aa_ref) & !is.na(aa_alt) & aa_ref != "" & aa_alt != "" ~
        paste0(VEP_SYMBOL, " ", aa_ref, VEP_Protein_position, aa_alt),
      !is.na(hgvs_c_short) & hgvs_c_short != "" ~
        paste0(VEP_SYMBOL, " ", hgvs_c_short),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# Build analysis subset — apply standard QC filters
mut.subset <- mut.all |>
  dplyr::select(multiome_sample, scDNA_variant_GRCh38, scDNA_variant_GRCh37,
                stage, has_scDNA, scDNA_panel_site, scDNA_mutation_called,
                scDNA_prop_cells_mutated, multiome_support, VEP_Consequence,
                VEP_IMPACT, VEP_SYMBOL, VEP_BIOTYPE, low_freq, repeated_indel,
                scDNA_prop_cells_mutated_adj, proportion_leukemic_cells,
                mut_string) |>
  group_by(multiome_sample, .drop = FALSE) |>
  right_join(pt.meta, by = c("multiome_sample" = "file_prefix")) |>
  left_join(k_cluster |> dplyr::select(X, k_4_Myeloid), by = c("patient" = "X")) |>
  group_by(patient) |>
  complete(mrd_pct, mut_string) |>
  fill(all_of(colnames(mut.subset)[c(2:6, 9:14)]), .direction = "downup") |>
  mutate(across(c(multiome_support, scDNA_prop_cells_mutated), ~ replace_na(., 0))) |>
  # Apply VEP impact and panel site filters
  dplyr::filter(VEP_IMPACT %in% c("MODERATE", "HIGH") | scDNA_panel_site == TRUE) |>
  dplyr::filter(VEP_SYMBOL != "OR2AJ1") |>
  # Remove common germline variants
  mutate(germline = if_else(scDNA_variant_GRCh38 %in%
                               germline.snps.common$combMut, TRUE, FALSE)) |>
  dplyr::filter(germline == FALSE) |>
  dplyr::filter(stage.x %in% c("IDX", "MRD"))
```

# Section 4: Build mutation.heatmap base — gene-level view

`mutation.heatmap` is the data frame used to build both heatmaps. It is
constructed twice (Sections 4 and 6) because the two heatmaps differ in their
y-axis ordering: gene-level by `symbol_n`, mutation-level by `variant_n`.

```{r build-heatmap-base-gene}
# Helper: assign pathway labels using PATHWAY_MAP defined in config
assign_pathway <- function(symbol_vec) {
  result <- rep("Other", length(symbol_vec))
  for (pathway in names(PATHWAY_MAP)) {
    result[symbol_vec %in% PATHWAY_MAP[[pathway]]] <- pathway
  }
  result
}

# Helper: standardise subtype labels using SUBTYPE_RECODE
recode_subtype <- function(subtype_vec) {
  dplyr::recode(subtype_vec, !!!SUBTYPE_RECODE, .default = subtype_vec)
}

build_heatmap_df <- function(mut.subset) {
  mut.subset |>
    group_by(VEP_SYMBOL) |>
    mutate(symbol_n = n_distinct(patient)) |>
    ungroup() |>
    group_by(scDNA_variant_GRCh37) |>
    mutate(variant_n = n_distinct(patient)) |>
    ungroup() |>
    group_by(patient) |>
    mutate(patient_n = n()) |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(support = case_when(
      multiome_support > 0  & !scDNA_panel_site ~ "multiome",
      multiome_support == 0 &  scDNA_panel_site ~ "panel site",
      multiome_support > 0  &  scDNA_panel_site ~ "multiome & panel",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )) |>
    group_by(VEP_SYMBOL) |>
    filter(all(symbol_n > 2 & symbol_n <= 15) | any(!is.na(support))) |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(pathway = assign_pathway(VEP_SYMBOL),
           subtype = recode_subtype(subtype))
}

mutation.heatmap.gene <- build_heatmap_df(mut.subset) |>
  mutate(
    patient    = fct_reorder(patient,    mrd_pct,   .fun = max,  .desc = TRUE),
    VEP_SYMBOL = fct_reorder(VEP_SYMBOL, symbol_n,  .fun = max,  .desc = FALSE),
    pathway    = fct_reorder(pathway,    multiome_support, .fun = sum, .desc = TRUE)
  )
```

# Section 5: Gene-level heatmap and metadata bar

```{r gene-heatmap, fig.height=6, fig.width=7}
p1 <- mutation.heatmap.gene |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_tile(aes(y = VEP_SYMBOL, x = stage.y,
                fill = scDNA_prop_cells_mutated_adj, color = support),
            width = 1, height = 1, linewidth = 1) +
  scale_fill_gradient(na.value = "white") +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2", na.value = NA) +
  ggh4x::facet_nested(
    pathway ~ k_4_Myeloid + patient + mrd_pct,
    space  = "free", scales = "free", drop = TRUE,
    resect = unit(0, "mm"), nest_line = element_line(colour = NA),
    strip  = ggh4x::strip_nested(size = "variable")
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 6),
        axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 5),
        legend.text  = element_text(size = 5),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 5),
        legend.key.size      = unit(0.125, "in"),
        panel.background     = ggh4x::element_part_rect(side = "all", colour = "black"),
        strip.background     = ggh4x::element_part_rect(side = "top", colour = "black"),
        strip.text           = element_text(size = 5),
        panel.spacing        = unit(0, "mm"))

pdf(file.path(dir.plots,
              "FilteredMutationSummary_GeneLevel_percentLeukemicAdj.pdf"),
    height = 6, width = 7)
p1
dev.off()

# Metadata bar (MRD% and subtype annotation for pheatmap)
meta.subset.gene <- mutation.heatmap.gene |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(multiome_sample, stage.y, subtype, patient, mrd_pct) |>
  distinct() |>
  mutate(patient  = fct_reorder(patient, mrd_pct, .fun = max, .desc = TRUE),
         subtype  = factor(subtype, levels = c("iAMP21", "KMT2Ar", "Ph-like", "Ph+"))) |>
  arrange(subtype, desc(mrd_pct))

sample.order.gene <- meta.subset.gene$multiome_sample
cols24 <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(9, "Set1"))(24)
names(cols24) <- unique(meta.subset.gene$patient)

mrd.mat <- meta.subset.gene |>
  select(multiome_sample, mrd_pct) |>
  data.frame() |>
  (\(x) { rownames(x) <- x$multiome_sample; x$multiome_sample <- NULL; x })() |>
  (\(x) { x[x > 0.05] <- 0.05; t(as.matrix(x)) })()

anno <- meta.subset.gene |>
  select(multiome_sample, patient, subtype) |>
  data.frame() |>
  (\(x) { rownames(x) <- x$multiome_sample; x$multiome_sample <- NULL; x })()

p2 <- pheatmap::pheatmap(
  mrd.mat,
  color               = colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(9, "Reds"))(100),
  cluster_rows        = FALSE, cluster_cols = FALSE,
  show_colnames       = TRUE, show_rownames = TRUE,
  annotation_col      = anno, annotation_names_col = TRUE,
  annotation_colors   = list(subtype = SUBTYPE_COLS, patient = cols24),
  fontsize            = 8
)

ggsave(p2,
       filename = file.path(dir.plots,
                             "FilteredMutationSummary_GeneLevel_Metadata.eps"),
       width = 16, height = 6, device = "eps")
```

---

# Section 6: Build mutation.heatmap base — mutation-level view

Rebuilt from `mut.subset` with y-axis ordered by `variant_n` (per-variant
patient frequency) rather than `symbol_n`, and using `mut_string` on the y-axis
instead of `VEP_SYMBOL`.

```{r build-heatmap-base-mutation}
mutation.heatmap.mut <- build_heatmap_df(mut.subset) |>
  mutate(
    patient               = fct_reorder(patient, mrd_pct, .fun = max, .desc = TRUE),
    mut_string            = fct_reorder(mut_string, variant_n, .fun = max, .desc = FALSE),
    scDNA_variant_GRCh38  = fct_reorder(scDNA_variant_GRCh38, variant_n, .fun = max, .desc = FALSE),
    VEP_SYMBOL            = fct_reorder(VEP_SYMBOL, symbol_n, .fun = max, .desc = TRUE),
    pathway               = fct_reorder(pathway, multiome_support, .fun = sum, .desc = TRUE)
  )
```

# Section 8: IDX → MRD mutation frequency change

## Top 15 most mutated genes at IDX and MRD

```{r top-mutated-genes}
# Build IDX/MRD wide table for paired comparisons
# idx_mrd_diff = MRD − IDX (positive = increased at MRD)
mutRatediff.df <- mutation.heatmap.mut |>
  left_join(pt.meta, by = c("multiome_sample" = "file_prefix")) |>
  filter(stage.x %in% c("IDX", "MRD"),
         low_freq == FALSE, repeated_indel == FALSE,
         !is.na(VEP_SYMBOL), VEP_BIOTYPE == "protein_coding",
         VEP_IMPACT %in% c("HIGH", "MODERATE")) |>
  dplyr::select(patient.x, multiome_sample, stage.x, scDNA_variant_GRCh37,
                scDNA_prop_cells_mutated_adj, VEP_SYMBOL, VEP_IMPACT, support) |>
  tidyr::complete(nesting(patient.x, scDNA_variant_GRCh37, VEP_SYMBOL,
                           VEP_IMPACT, support), stage.x) |>
  pivot_wider(id_cols     = c("patient.x", "scDNA_variant_GRCh37", "VEP_SYMBOL",
                               "VEP_IMPACT", "support"),
              names_from  = "stage.x",
              values_from = c("multiome_sample", "scDNA_prop_cells_mutated_adj")) |>
  replace_na(list(scDNA_prop_cells_mutated_adj_IDX = 0,
                  scDNA_prop_cells_mutated_adj_MRD = 0)) |>
  mutate(idx_mrd_diff = scDNA_prop_cells_mutated_adj_MRD -
                        scDNA_prop_cells_mutated_adj_IDX)

# Helper: top 15 most-mutated genes at a given timepoint
plot_top_mut_genes <- function(df, stage_col, stage_label) {
  top_genes <- df |>
    filter(.data[[stage_col]] > 0) |>
    group_by(VEP_SYMBOL) |>
    summarise(distinctPt = n_distinct(patient.x), .groups = "drop") |>
    slice_max(order_by = distinctPt, n = 15, with_ties = TRUE)

  plot_data <- df |>
    filter(VEP_SYMBOL %in% top_genes$VEP_SYMBOL,
           .data[[stage_col]] > 0) |>
    group_by(VEP_SYMBOL) |>
    summarise(n_pat = n_distinct(patient.x), .groups = "drop") |>
    arrange(n_pat)

  df |>
    filter(VEP_SYMBOL %in% plot_data$VEP_SYMBOL,
           .data[[stage_col]] > 0) |>
    mutate(VEP_SYMBOL = factor(VEP_SYMBOL, levels = plot_data$VEP_SYMBOL)) |>
    ggplot(aes(y = VEP_SYMBOL, x = .data[[stage_col]])) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(aes(color = support, shape = VEP_IMPACT),
                size = 1.5, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_text(data = plot_data,
              aes(x = 0.85, y = VEP_SYMBOL,
                  label = paste0("n = ", n_pat)),
              hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1.2, size = 3) +
    scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1", na.value = "darkgray") +
    xlim(0, 1) +
    labs(x     = paste(stage_label, "Adj. Mutation Proportion"),
         y     = "Genes",
         title = paste("Top 15 Most Mutated Genes at", stage_label, "by Patient")) +
    theme_bw()
}

p.mrd <- plot_top_mut_genes(mutRatediff.df, "scDNA_prop_cells_mutated_adj_MRD", "MRD")
p.idx <- plot_top_mut_genes(mutRatediff.df, "scDNA_prop_cells_mutated_adj_IDX", "IDX")

pdf(file.path(dir.plots, "AdjMutRankedByPatientFrequency.pdf"), height = 5, width = 8)
ggarrange(plotlist = list(p.mrd, p.idx), legend = "right", common.legend = TRUE)
dev.off()
```

## Frequency change histograms and scatter

```{r mut-change-plots}
# All-sample histogram of IDX→MRD difference
n_small_change <- sum(mutRatediff.df$idx_mrd_diff < MUT_CHANGE_HIST_THRESHOLD,
                       na.rm = TRUE)

p.hist <- ggplot(mutRatediff.df, aes(x = idx_mrd_diff)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "steelblue", color = "black") +
  annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 125, hjust = 1, vjust = 1.1,
           label = paste("Mutations with d < 5%:", n_small_change, "of",
                          nrow(mutRatediff.df)), size = 3.5) +
  labs(x = "Difference in Mutation Frequency (MRD \u2212 IDX)", y = "Mutations") +
  theme_bw()

# 100% leukemic samples only
mutRatediff_AllLeuk.df <- mutation.heatmap.mut |>
  left_join(pt.meta, by = c("multiome_sample" = "file_prefix")) |>
  filter(stage.x %in% c("IDX", "MRD"),
         low_freq == FALSE, repeated_indel == FALSE,
         !is.na(VEP_SYMBOL), VEP_BIOTYPE == "protein_coding",
         VEP_IMPACT %in% c("HIGH", "MODERATE"),
         proportion_leukemic_cells == 1) |>
  dplyr::select(patient.x, multiome_sample, stage.x, scDNA_variant_GRCh37,
                scDNA_prop_cells_mutated_adj, VEP_SYMBOL, VEP_IMPACT, support) |>
  tidyr::complete(nesting(patient.x, scDNA_variant_GRCh37, VEP_SYMBOL,
                           VEP_IMPACT, support), stage.x) |>
  pivot_wider(id_cols     = c("patient.x", "scDNA_variant_GRCh37", "VEP_SYMBOL",
                               "VEP_IMPACT", "support"),
              names_from  = "stage.x",
              values_from = c("multiome_sample", "scDNA_prop_cells_mutated_adj")) |>
  replace_na(list(scDNA_prop_cells_mutated_adj_IDX = 0,
                  scDNA_prop_cells_mutated_adj_MRD = 0)) |>
  mutate(idx_mrd_diff = scDNA_prop_cells_mutated_adj_MRD -
                        scDNA_prop_cells_mutated_adj_IDX)

n_small_change_leuk <- sum(mutRatediff_AllLeuk.df$idx_mrd_diff <
                              MUT_CHANGE_HIST_THRESHOLD, na.rm = TRUE)

p.hist.leuk <- ggplot(mutRatediff_AllLeuk.df, aes(x = idx_mrd_diff)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "steelblue", color = "black") +
  annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 125, hjust = 1, vjust = 1.1,
           label = paste("Mutations with d < 5%:", n_small_change_leuk, "of",
                          nrow(mutRatediff_AllLeuk.df)), size = 3.5) +
  labs(x = "Difference in Mutation Frequency\n(MRD \u2212 IDX, 100% Leukemic Samples Only)",
       y = "Mutations") +
  theme_bw()

n_gt1pct <- sum(mutRatediff.df$scDNA_prop_cells_mutated_adj_IDX > 0.01, na.rm = TRUE)
p.hist.idx <- ggplot(mutRatediff.df, aes(x = scDNA_prop_cells_mutated_adj_IDX)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "steelblue", color = "black") +
  annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 125, hjust = 1, vjust = 1.1,
           label = paste("Mutations > 1% freq:", n_gt1pct, "of",
                          nrow(mutRatediff.df)), size = 3.5) +
  labs(x = "IDX Mutation Frequency", y = "Mutations") +
  theme_bw()

pdf(file.path(dir.plots, "MutDiffHistogram.pdf"), height = 4, width = 4)
p.hist; p.hist.leuk; p.hist.idx
dev.off()

# Paired change plot for genes present in > 2 patients
mrdIncrease.df <- mutRatediff.df |>
  group_by(VEP_SYMBOL) |>
  mutate(avgChange_symbol     = mean(idx_mrd_diff),

gene_labels <- mrdIncrease.df |>
```

## IDX vs. MRD scatter plot

```{r simple-change-scatter}
simple_change_df <- mutation.heatmap.mut |>
  left_join(pt.meta, by = c("multiome_sample" = "file_prefix")) |>
  filter(stage.x %in% c("IDX", "MRD"),
         VEP_BIOTYPE == "protein_coding",
         low_freq == FALSE, repeated_indel == FALSE, !is.na(VEP_SYMBOL)) |>
  dplyr::select(patient.x, multiome_sample, stage.x, scDNA_variant_GRCh37,
                scDNA_prop_cells_mutated_adj, VEP_SYMBOL, VEP_IMPACT, mut_string) |>
  pivot_wider(id_cols     = c("patient.x", "scDNA_variant_GRCh37", "VEP_SYMBOL",

              names_from  = "stage.x",
              values_from = c("multiome_sample", "scDNA_prop_cells_mutated_adj")) |>
  replace_na(list(scDNA_prop_cells_mutated_adj_IDX = 0,

  mutate(idx_mrd_diff  = abs(scDNA_prop_cells_mutated_adj_IDX -
```

# Section 9: Mission Bio panel characterisation

```{r panel-info}
panel.tab <- read.csv(path.panel.tab)

# Amplicon counts per gene
gene.count <- panel.tab |>
  dplyr::select(gene, AmpID) |>
  distinct() |>
  filter(!is.na(AmpID)) |>
  group_by(gene) |>
  mutate(amp_count = n()) |>
  ungroup() |>
  dplyr::select(-AmpID) |>
  distinct() |>
  arrange(desc(amp_count))

# Mutation counts per gene
mut.count <- panel.tab |>
  dplyr::select(gene, gene.mutation) |>
  distinct() |>
  filter(!is.na(gene.mutation)) |>
  group_by(gene) |>
  summarize(mut_count = n()) |>
  arrange(desc(mut_count))

# Standardise Mut.Origin strings (collapse ordering variants)
mut.origin <- panel.tab |>
  dplyr::select(gene, Mut.Origin) |>
  distinct() |>
  group_by(gene) |>
  summarize(Mut.Origin = paste(sort(unique(Mut.Origin)), collapse = ", "),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(Mut.Origin = recode(Mut.Origin,
    "DIAGNOSIS, RELAPSE"           = "DIAGNOSIS, RELAPSE, SOMATIC",
    "RELAPSE"                      = "RELAPSE, SOMATIC",
    "DIAGNOSIS"                    = "DIAGNOSIS, SOMATIC",
    "DIAGNOSIS, SOMATIC, RELAPSE"  = "DIAGNOSIS, RELAPSE, SOMATIC",
    "RELAPSE, DIAGNOSIS"           = "DIAGNOSIS, RELAPSE, SOMATIC",
    "SOMATIC, RELAPSE"             = "RELAPSE, SOMATIC",
    "SOMATIC"                      = "SOMATIC, Unknown",
    "GERMLINE"                     = "GERMLINE, Unknown",
    .default = Mut.Origin
  ))

gene.count <- left_join(gene.count, mut.origin, by = "gene")
mut.count  <- left_join(mut.count,  mut.origin, by = "gene")

# vals: unique Mut.Origin levels present in the data (used for consistent
# colour scale breaks across both plots)
vals <- unique(c(gene.count$Mut.Origin, mut.count$Mut.Origin))

panel.cols <- c(
  "#76c5ad", "#49b192", "#1b9e77",
  "#e89f67", "#e17f35", "#d95f02",
  "#aca9d1", "#918dc2", "#7570b3",
  "#f17fb9", "#ec54a1", "#e7298a"
)
names(panel.cols) <- c(
  "DIAGNOSIS, SOMATIC", "DIAGNOSIS, GERMLINE", "DIAGNOSIS, SOMATIC, GERMLINE",
  "RELAPSE, SOMATIC",   "RELAPSE, GERMLINE",   "RELAPSE, SOMATIC, GERMLINE",
  "DIAGNOSIS, RELAPSE, SOMATIC", "DIAGNOSIS, RELAPSE, GERMLINE",
  "DIAGNOSIS, GERMLINE, RELAPSE, SOMATIC",
  "SOMATIC, Unknown", "GERMLINE, Unknown", "SOMATIC, GERMLINE, Unknown"
)

p.amp <- gene.count |>
  filter(amp_count > 1) |>
  ggplot(aes(y = reorder(gene, amp_count), x = amp_count, fill = Mut.Origin)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = panel.cols, breaks = vals, labels = vals) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.text = element_text(size = 5),
        legend.title.position = "top", panel.grid = element_blank())

p.mut <- mut.count |>
  filter(mut_count > 2) |>
  ggplot(aes(y = reorder(gene, mut_count), x = mut_count, fill = Mut.Origin)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = panel.cols, breaks = vals, labels = vals) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.text = element_text(size = 5),
        legend.title.position = "top", panel.grid = element_blank())

ggsave(p.amp, file = file.path(dir.plots, "ampliconCountForMBPanel.pdf"),
       height = 6, width = 4)
ggsave(p.mut, file = file.path(dir.plots, "MutCountForMBPanel.pdf"),
       height = 6, width = 4)
```

# Section 10: PeCAN overlap

```{r pecan-overlap}
# Build merged PeCAN table from per-gene TSV files (skip if cached)
if (!file.exists(path.pecan.merged)) {
  pecan.files <- list.files(path.pecan.dir, pattern = "\\.tsv$", full.names = TRUE)
  pecan.names <- sub("\\.tsv$", "", basename(pecan.files))
  pecan.dfs   <- pecan.files |>
    lapply(\(f) read_tsv(f, show_col_types = FALSE)) |>
    setNames(pecan.names)
  # Drop files missing required column
  pecan.dfs <- pecan.dfs[sapply(pecan.dfs, \(df) "Mutation" %in% colnames(df))]
  keep_cols <- c("Mutation", "Sample", "Specimen", "Genome pos.", "Ref", "Alt",
                 "Mut. Origin", "Data set")
  merged_df <- pecan.dfs |>
    lapply(\(x) {
      x <- dplyr::select(x, all_of(keep_cols))
      x$gene <- NULL; x
    }) |>
    imap(\(df, nm) { df$gene <- nm; df }) |>
    lapply(\(df) mutate(df, across(all_of(keep_cols), as.character))) |>
    bind_rows() |>
    mutate(Mutation_Combined = paste(`Genome pos.`, Ref, Alt, sep = ":"))
  write_tsv(merged_df, path.pecan.merged)
} else {
  merged_df <- read_tsv(path.pecan.merged, show_col_types = FALSE)
}

cat("Cohort mutations in PeCAN:",
    sum(mut.all$scDNA_variant_GRCh37 %in% merged_df$Mutation_Combined), "\n")

merged_overlap <- merged_df |>
  filter(Mutation_Combined %in% mut.all$scDNA_variant_GRCh37) |>
  group_by(Mutation_Combined) |>
  mutate(patient_n = n()) |>
  ungroup() |>
  dplyr::select(Mutation, Mutation_Combined, gene, patient_n) |>
  distinct() |>
  mutate(Mutation_Name = paste(gene, Mutation, sep = "_"),
         Mutation_Name = reorder(Mutation_Name, -patient_n)) |>
  left_join(mut.all |> dplyr::select(scDNA_variant_GRCh37, scDNA_panel_site) |>
              distinct(),
            by = c("Mutation_Combined" = "scDNA_variant_GRCh37"))

p.pecan.bar <- ggplot(merged_overlap,
                       aes(x = reorder(Mutation_Name, -patient_n),
                           y = patient_n, fill = gene)) +
  geom_col() + geom_text(aes(label = patient_n), vjust = -0.5, size = 3) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "plasma") +
  labs(x = "Mutation", y = "Patient Count", title = "Mutations by Gene") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "none")

# PeCAN frequency rank plot
log1p10_trans <- trans_new(
  name      = "log1p10",
  transform = \(x) log10(x + 1),
  inverse   = \(x) 10^x - 1
)

mut.count.pecan <- merged_df |>
  dplyr::filter(Specimen == "DIAGNOSIS") |>
  group_by(Mutation_Combined) |>
  mutate(patient_n = n()) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(patient_fraction = patient_n / length(unique(Sample))) |>
  dplyr::select(Mutation_Combined, patient_n, patient_fraction, gene) |>
  distinct(Mutation_Combined, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  arrange(desc(patient_fraction)) |>
  mutate(rank    = min_rank(-patient_fraction),
         overlap = Mutation_Combined %in% mut.all$scDNA_variant_GRCh37)

pos <- position_jitter(height = 0.00025, width = 200, seed = 123)

p.pecan.rank <- ggplot(mut.count.pecan, aes(x = rank, y = patient_fraction)) +
  geom_jitter(position = pos, alpha = 0.5, aes(color = overlap)) +
  geom_text_repel(data = subset(mut.count.pecan, overlap),
                   aes(label = gene), position = pos,
                   max.overlaps = 15, size = 3) +
  ggtitle("PeCAN Mutation Frequency Across Cohort")

p.pecan.hist <- ggplot(mut.count.pecan, aes(x = patient_fraction)) +
  geom_histogram() +
  scale_y_continuous(trans  = log1p10_trans,
                     breaks = c(0, 1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000, 40000)) +
  labs(x = "Fraction of Cohort with Specific Mutation",
       y = "Frequency (log1p scale)") +
  theme_bw()

pdf(file.path(dir.plots, "PeCAN_OverlapWithFilteredMutations.pdf"),
    height = 4, width = 6)
p.pecan.bar; p.pecan.rank; p.pecan.hist
dev.off()
```
